$comment: Inherited from the backend, where `security-check` was commented out of
pull-request.yaml, so this config had never actually gated anything.
MDRS-15 wires it into CI (.github/workflows/ci.yaml, `security` job).
package-manager was 'npm' and is now 'pnpm': the merged repo has a single
pnpm-lock.yaml and no package-lock.json anywhere, so the npm reader found
The allowlist is a ratchet, not an amnesty. `audit-ci --package-manager pnpm`
on c59d467 reported 28 high advisories across the 24 GHSAs listed below
(0 critical, 13 moderate, 2 low; moderate/low are not gated). Every one is
pre-existing debt that MDRS-8 already routed to MDRS-21 — mostly transitive
exceljs>brace-expansion, and xlsx (MDRS-8 FU-5: unfloorable, must be
replaced rather than overridden). Gating on them today would red-light every
PR. With them allowlisted the gate still fails on any NEW high or critical
advisory, which is the property that was missing.
When MDRS-21 fixes one, delete its line here in the same PR.
